fullPassage: Grace Hopper was born in New York in 1906. She showed an interest in mechanics at an early age, often taking apart appliances and putting them back together. She earned degrees in mathematics and physics at Vassar College and later received a PhD in mathematics from Yale. Upon graduating, she returned to Vassar as a professor. Following the attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941, which caused the US to enter World War II, Hopper joined the military. In 1944, she was assigned to a computer project at Harvard University. Her team helped create an early version of an electronic computer. After the war, she took part in the creation of UNIVAC, the first all-electronic digital computer. She eventually reached the rank of commander and was recognized internationally for her work with computers. In 1973, she became the first woman to be named a distinguished fellow of the British Computer Society.

det.analysis:
'인정받았다'는 그녀가 '인정받은' 대상이므로 수동태예요. be동사 was + 과거분사 recognized로 씁니다: was recognized.

'국제적으로'는 부사 internationally로 동사 뒤에 붙여요: was recognized internationally.

'~에 대해/~으로'는 for로 이어, 자신의 컴퓨터 관련 업적을 for her work with computers(컴퓨터와 관련된 그녀의 업적으로)로 마무리해요.

순서: was recognized(수동태) + internationally(국제적으로) + for her work with computers(컴퓨터 관련 업적으로).
det.tip: be recognized for ~ = ~으로 인정받다(수동) / work with computers = 컴퓨터 관련 업적. was recognized internationally for her work with computers
